title: Parish Event Overlap Conflicts
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:ops event_type=* overlap_conflict=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(overlap_conflict="yes",1,0))) as matched by event_type
| eval an_overlap_conflict_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_overlap_conflict_pct
description: Measures the percentage of parish calendar events that end with an overlap conflict by event type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which event type are helping or hurting parish calendar events.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an overlap conflict` on `faith:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `event_type`.
visualization: Table of event type with percentage of parish calendar events ending with an overlap conflict.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often an overlap conflict happens for each event type so you can see where parish calendar events go smoothly or get stuck.
